title: Add 2 numbers in LL
stepTitle: Learn LinkedList [Single LL, Double LL, Medium, Hard Problems]
category: Learn LinkedList [Single LL, Double LL, Medium, Hard Problems]
problemStatement: Add two numbers represented as linked lists with digits in reverse order.
intuition: Reverse order is a gift: the heads are the least significant digits, so you can add left to right exactly like grade-school addition.

approaches.title: Optimal: single pass with carry
approaches.idea: Loop while either list remains or a carry is pending.
approaches.whyWorks: The `or carry` condition handles the final carry-out uniformly.

edgeCases: Final carry creating a new digit (99 + 1)
patternRecognition: Carry propagation appears in add-1, big-integer addition and binary addition
followUps: Digits in forward order (use stacks or reverse first)

interviewInsight: The `while l1 or l2 or carry` loop condition is the clean idiom; writing three separate loops is the giveaway.
